svg.title: From a ggml graph to device work
svg.desc: Swimlane timeline, time running down, with lanes llama.cpp, ggml-tesseract, tsr_transport, card DRAM, the control core (firmware) and the units. Model load: supports_op probe, set_tensor of weights, conversion and repacking, rows written at W_OFF on every channel; the firmware image is loaded through the CSR loader, verified by read-back CRC, booted, and answers with HELLO. Each launch: activations written to the IO window, the split lowered to an op list in the OPL region (cache hit: no write), the 8-word launch descriptor pushed by posted CSR writes; the control core pops it, validates it and runs the graph kernel, which issues the tile ops of every record to the unit queues; cluster c streams weights from channel c; one completion record with status and first error is posted; the host polls, reads the result back and the CPU continues with attention, norms and RoPE. A dashed note marks M7, one launch per token, as planned.
